page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-60-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 60 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 30 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The instance is equipped with 480 GB of RAM, providing a high resource density of 8.0 GB per core. Storage is bundled via four local NVMe SSDs totaling 1608 GB, while no dedicated GPU hardware is present.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance characteristics, particularly in multi-core processing and memory-intensive operations. The instance achieved top-tier results in stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, Passmark CPU scores, and Redis SET operations, which reached 78.41 million operations per second. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is exceptionally high at 4247.51 GB/sec, though large-block uncached read and write bandwidths fall into the average range at 144.14 GB/sec and 54.27 GB/sec respectively.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and fast local NVMe storage, this server is highly cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads and high-throughput databases. It is well-suited for large-scale database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks. However, the lack of a GPU limits its utility for heavy deep learning training workloads.
